node.title: M720 MITM correctness gate
node.statement: The MITM scanner used for the h in (6,20] band correctly detects known h=3,4,5 trade/census facts and distinguishes toral or paid cores from non-toral active cores.
node.attack_surface: connect scanner equations to the banked C1a/C1b trade equations; off-laptop gate replay is evidence only
node.falsifier: a known small-h trade missed by the scanner, or a paid/toral calibration core misclassified as an unpaid non-toral active core
